title: Five Winters and One Short Note
subtitle: 人际交往 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 人际交往（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通）
meta: 主题语境：人际交往（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通）　|　核心词汇：excuse　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 excuse 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1953 my brother ① made an excuse that no teacher in the school would have accepted, and he said the making was the whole of the winter. The ② excuse, meaning the reason itself and not the truth, ran five winters and stayed unaccepted in the book; an excuse, he said, is the only thing in a school that is judged by how long it is left unaccepted.

Every ③ excuse in that school had the same short note beside it, and the ④ excuse at the far side, meaning the one they kept for the parents and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. An excuse, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to accept; my brother said the accepting is the part that fills five winters.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the excuse was the whole of the matter, meaning the apology and not the reason. The ⑥ excuse, meaning the apology and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody accepts; excuse, he said, is either something you make or the only word that means both a reason and an apology. He said the apology is the part they remember.

By 1958 the ⑦ excuse had become a line in a letter, and the letter had become an argument about the short note. The ⑧ excuse of the whole thing, my brother wrote in January, was one school and five winters of accepting; excuse, he said, is either the one at the far side or the reason you learned to accept. He said the accepting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ excuse I remember is the one accepted in the letter, which closed in 1960 and is still described as the quietest in the school. An ⑩ excuse, my mother said in 1962, is the only one that improves by being accepted; every excuse, she said, is an apology that has agreed to look like a reason. She said the apology was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 借口；理由（指学校里每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 借口（指那个理由本身，与实情相对）
C. 固定搭配：make an excuse 找一个借口
D. n. 借口（指留给家长的那一个）
E. n. 借口（抽象总称，指一所学校的托词之事）
F. n. 借口（指信上写到、被接受的那一个）
G. n. 道歉；辩解（指一件事里人人都等却无人接受的那样东西）
H. n. 辩解（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人接受的那样东西）

answers.why: make an excuse 意为“找一个借口”，1953 年哥哥找了一个学校里没有一位老师肯接受的借口。
excuse 意为“借口”，指那个理由本身而不是实情，它经过了五个冬天而在簿子上没有记号。
excuse 意为“借口”，指学校里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一张短短的字条。
excuse 意为“借口”，指留给家长的那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
excuse 意为“道歉、辩解”，指一件事里人人都等却无人接受的那样东西，叔叔说这个辩解就是那件事的全部。
excuse 意为“辩解”，指人人都等却无人接受的那样东西而不是那个理由，是事情里人人都等、却无人接受的东西。
excuse 意为“借口”，指信上写到、被接受的那一个，到 1958 年这一个成了信里的一行。
excuse 意为“借口”，哥哥一月写道，整件事的托词之事是一所学校和五个冬天的接受。
excuse 意为“借口”，我记得的是信上接受的那一个，1960 年结束了，至今仍被说成学校里最安静的一个。
excuse 为抽象总称，母亲 1962 年说，一个借口是唯一会因为被好好接受而变得更好的东西。
